title: Tenma Saki — Feeling Like An Incognito Idol〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: One Small Trip Before a Big Journey

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Looks like everyone's here!
Alright...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We can now commence the “Let's Eat the Yokohama Souvenirs Together Party”♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That name is quite literal...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But, at least it's easy to understand.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. It's quite the sight to see souvenirs from all four of you lined up like this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, to think that 8 desks together wasn't enough for all of it to fit!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Was it really okay to buy this much on our account?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It was A-okay♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: There were soooooo many things there that we all wanted to try a bunch of stuff too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, this is a token of our gratitude for always helping us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right... Well, in that case, I won't hold back.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Eat as much as you want!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! Then I'm gonna open this box of shoe-shaped cookies♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, they're so cute. Who bought these?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I did♪ It was me!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think I'll open this brick-shaped mini cake.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I bought that. I had the sample and it was so fluffy and delicious.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What? It was fluffy? Haha, that's interesting since it looks like a brick.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... Everything looks so good that I can't choose...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then how about this? It's a mooncake that looks like a panda's face. It has red bean paste and apples in it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Apples?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wow, it's kind of rare for you to buy sweets with apples that aren't apple pie.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Well, Chinatown isn't really known for apple pies...
I tried a sample of these and they were really good, so I got them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whether it tastes good or not is what's important. I'll try these.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't hold back, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, okay... What did you buy, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Me? I got this. It's a Cantonese sponge cake.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, it's a sponge cake...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's really good and not too sweet either.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, we tried those too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My group and I were talking about how they were so soft you could just keep eating them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sounds nice. We went shopping at the Red Brick Center, so we weren't able to go to Chinatown.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If we only had another day then we totally would've gone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then why don't you all just go together? You should bring your instruments too, then it'll be like a tour♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oooh! That sounds awesome!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A tour, huh? If we get an agency and start working with them, we'll probably be performing at a bunch of different live houses...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Really?! Does that mean we'll get to go to Yokohama? I wanna go to Okinawa too!
Wait, will I need to get a passport or something?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? A passport?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't think we're at a level to be performing overseas yet...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. I think we'd probably be performing somewhere around Shibuya.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even if we get to go somewhere like Yokohama that's good for sightseeing... Our performance is going to be our top priority, so I don't think we'll have time for that, you know?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that's true...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I think going to different places and experiencing a variety of things would also be good for you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Also, I'm sure you'll have time after your show. So you can all go sightseeing then, no?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right! Exactly!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! If we get to go to different places to do shows, let's eat good food and give some energetic performances♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hold on, Saki. You're prioritizing the eating.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What? Not at all♪ It's about doing your best after eating the local delicacies!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure we'll get more motivation after having some of the local food.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You have a point...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
You two are too soft on her.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe. Softer than the Cantonese sponge cake? KAITO, may I have some of that♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: C'mon, you guys eat too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay.
